text: Done in 236550f. Fix button on findings in the Assessment tab and file inspector (head release only; earlier releases offer none). Editor opens on the target with the suggestion applied and a 'Suggested fix' note at the top stating the value, its basis and the authored value; reason stays empty and required; tables select and scroll to the first flagged row; Cancel returns to where Fix was chosen (assessment tab or the file). Deviation from criterion 1: the console has no client-side authority information, so Fix follows the existing Correct/Add sidecar convention: shown to all, and the server's refusal is explained. Probes: fix-tr-suggests-sidecar, fix-events-selects-row, fix-in-inspector-head-only.
